evidence_class: mocked: isolated hook state, fixture brain packs, fake clock and gate lifts; no live target qualification claimed
interfaces: Metrics.record accepts a preauthenticated Grant, immutable operation identity and fixed-schema delivery, gate or reference metadata. Scope comes from the grant corpus and project membership; runtime observations derive that scope from the existing project resolver and selected brain.

Metrics.events and Metrics.report authorize brain and project before reading the persistent store. Session, task, context, incident, lesson and operation identifiers are pseudonymous within the installation, brain and project namespace.

Metrics.review accepts only a principal in trusted adapter operator configuration with a matching scope grant. A request cannot set its own operator role. Reviews are immutable and do not infer usefulness from deliveries, references, tool counts or overrides.

task_context.offer records supported delivery, deduplication, missing context, disabled delivery and unsupported events without storing pack text. A rendered service failure remains a retrieval failure even when its diagnostic notice is delivered.
The gate dispatcher records effective allow, deny, observe, off, lifted and fail-open outcomes for the brain gate. Receipt age is an observed metadata value; no metric claims comprehension.

states.accepted: Fixed-schema observations authorized for the selected brain and project, references tied to delivered context and separately authorized operator assessments.
states.committed: SQLite stores immutable observations and reviews under the agentihooks brain state home. Receipts and non-brain gate logs retain their preceding contracts; a crashed brain gate now logs a fixed fail-open detail instead of its exception text, so no memory or secret content reaches the gate log.
states.externally_verified: None. Live G10 verification remains outstanding.

metrics.brain_gate_false_block_rate: Operator-reviewed false denials divided by operator-reviewed denials; null when no denial has been reviewed. An operator lift alone is not a false-block ruling.
metrics.context_delivery_failures: Observed missing, disabled or unsupported delivery outcomes. A successful retrieval response is not a target delivery observation. Delivered means the context notice was handed to the target injector; target receipt is not confirmed. An empty retrieval handed to the injector counts as delivered and is classified separately in retrieval outcomes.
metrics.context_service_failures: Historical retrieval failures remain visible after successful recovery; the degraded flag describes the latest observation for each session.
metrics.usefulness: Delivered context, explicitly referenced context and operator-reviewed useful or irrelevant context remain distinct. References and reviews do not store prompt text.

remaining_limitations: Live G10 target qualification is separate from mocked acceptance fixtures and remains outstanding.
Operator review and reference submission are library interfaces for authenticated adapters; no new user interface or unauthenticated network endpoint is added.
The preceding local consultation receipt is not a cryptographic boundary against a process that controls its own hook state. Metrics preserve that compatibility contract.

Runtime observations derive their grant from the existing project resolver and selected brain in the same process; preauthenticated grants from adapters apply to Metrics.record callers outside the hook path.
Runtime delivery and gate observations use a fresh operation identity per hook event, so the replay guard deduplicates only callers that supply a stable identity.
Runtime observations record the task transition purpose only; search and refresh purposes are accepted by the schema but not yet emitted.
Runtime grant scope comes from the project resolver rather than a fixture grant or operator role; that path awaits a ruling on the ledger.
